heritageholding-heritage-holding:ashbyhq.description: Talent Acquisition Coordinator Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid) Position Overview The Talent Acquisition Coordinator will support full-cycle recruiting efforts across multiple portfolio companies. This role is highly hands-on and offers exposure to sourcing, candidate evaluation, interview coordination, and recruiting operations within a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and eager to build a career in talent acquisition, recruiting, or human resources. This individual will work closely with the Talent Acquisition team and company leadership to help attract and hire top talent. Responsibilities Recruitment Support - Support full-cycle recruiting efforts across Heritage Holding's portfolio companies - Post and manage job advertisements across various job boards and recruiting platforms. - Source candidates through LinkedIn, Indeed, referrals, and other recruiting channels. - Conduct initial candidate outreach and screening calls. - Maintain accurate candidate records within the applicant tracking system - Ashby. - Review resumes and identify qualified candidates for open positions. - Maintain candidate communication throughout the hiring process - Conduct reference checks and assist with offer preparation. Candidate Experience - Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process. - Ensure timely communication and follow-up with applicants. - Maintain a professional and positive candidate experience from application through onboarding. Recruiting Operations - Track recruiting metrics and hiring activity. - Maintain recruiting pipelines and candidate databases. - Assist with onboarding coordination for new hires. - Support process improvements and recruiting initiatives. - Prepare hiring reports and recruiting updates for management. Employer Branding & Administrative Support - Assist with maintaining company career pages and job board profiles. - Support recruiting-related content and employer branding initiatives. - Assist with newsletters and internal communications as needed. Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in psychology, human resources, business, or a related field - 0–2 years of experience in recruiting, human resources, administration, customer service, or a related field including internships - Strong organizational and time management skills. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. - High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. - Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. - Experience with LinkedIn, ATS platforms, or recruiting tools is a plus. - Professional, dependable, and able to handle confidential information with discretion. Preferred Traits - Strong work ethic and willingness to learn. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. - Self-starter who takes initiative and follows through on tasks. - Positive attitude and strong interpersonal skills. - Interest in recruiting, talent acquisition, and human resources. What You'll Gain - Exposure to recruiting across multiple industries and portfolio companies. - Experience with full-cycle talent acquisition processes. - Direct mentorship from recruiting leadership. - Opportunity for growth into a Talent Acquisition Specialist or HR role.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c6d29894-ddce-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Quality Control Inspector based in Canada. This is an opportunity for an experienced welding and quality professional to support a major turnaround project in Fort McMurray, Alberta. You will play a critical role in ensuring welding, pipeline, facility, mechanical, and construction activities meet required quality standards. Working across an industrial project environment, you’ll inspect work, verify documentation, and help maintain compliance with specifications, codes, and client expectations. The role combines hands-on field inspection with quality documentation, testing coordination, and project closeout activities. You’ll work closely with project teams, clients, regulators, and third-party inspectors to identify issues and support timely corrective actions. Strong technical knowledge, attention to detail, and sound judgment will be essential to maintaining safe and reliable project outcomes. The position is suited to a certified CWB Level 2 Welding Inspector who is comfortable working in demanding turnaround and industrial environments. Perform daily quality inspections across welding, pipeline, facility, mechanical, and turnaround activities to verify compliance with project requirements. Inspect completed and in-progress work against approved drawings, technical specifications, applicable codes, and client standards. Coordinate and witness quality testing activities, including non-destructive examination (NDE), hydrostatic testing, and material verification. Verify that materials are properly documented, traceable, approved, and compliant before installation. Maintain Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), including required hold points, witness points, inspections, and client approvals. Review welding documentation, inspection records, material traceability, and turnover documentation for completeness and accuracy. Identify non-conformances, document quality issues, and support teams in developing and implementing corrective actions. Prepare clear and accurate inspection reports, quality records, and project closeout packages. Participate in client, regulatory, and third-party inspections, audits, and quality reviews. Collaborate with project and operations teams to resolve quality concerns while maintaining project schedules and applicable standards. Requirements: CWB Welding Inspector Level 2 certification is required. Current CSTS, WHMIS 2015, H2S Alive, First Aid , and other applicable industry safety certifications. Previous quality inspection experience on pipeline, facility, industrial, oil and gas, or turnaround projects . Strong practical knowledge of welding inspection, construction quality processes, NDE, pressure testing, and material traceability. Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, P&IDs, isometric drawings, and technical specifications . Familiarity with CSA, ASME, API , and client-specific quality standards is an asset. Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, communication abilities, and practical problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced turnaround environment while maintaining a high standard of quality and documentation. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and quality management or reporting systems. Willingness and ability to work in Fort McMurray, Alberta in support of an upcoming turnaround project. Benefits: Competitive compensation , based on experience and qualifications. Full-time employment within an operations-focused project environment. Opportunity to contribute to a major industrial turnaround project. Hands-on exposure to welding, pipeline, facility, mechanical, and quality activities. Opportunity to work alongside project teams, clients, regulators, and third-party inspectors. Professional experience across industrial, energy, and construction quality environments.
